task_as_published.stimulus: tonic step input to ONE DNg100 (the one innervating the LEFT leg neuropils; soma in the right hemisphere)
task_as_published.readout: leg motor neurons of the front-leg network; motor rhythmicity score (autocorrelation-based, 0..1), threshold 0.5
task_as_published.model: rate model, rectified tanh, W = signed synapse counts (sign from predicted NT: ACh +, GABA/Glu -), global scale b=0.03, gain/threshold normalised by neuron size, randomised biophysical parameters
task_as_published.search: stochastic iterative pruning of interneurons (removal prob ~ 1/max rate), 1024 screens per dataset, keep removal if rhythmicity >= 0.5

E1.role: excitatory; receives DNg100 input; individually necessary (all 4 datasets)

E2.role: excitatory; strongest target of E1; individually necessary (all 4 datasets)

I1.role: inhibitory feedback onto E1/E2 (modal partner in MANC only); not individually necessary

I2.role: inhibitory feedback (modal partner in FANC, MaleCNS, BANC); not individually necessary

E3.role: excitatory, contralateral soma; in FANC modal circuit

minimal_circuits_DNg100_pruning.summary: E1 and E2 present in essentially all solutions; inhibitory partner I1 or I2 (E1+E2+(I1 or I2) in 3521/4096 = 86.0% of screens)

ids_as_published._note: IDs are dataset-native and version-specific. MaleCNS IDs come from the authors' extraction dated 2026-02-10 (before MaleCNS v1.0 was released on 2026-06-08, i.e. presumably male-cns:v0.9; version not stated in the paper). T1L = front-left leg copy used in the simulations.

signed_counts_as_published._note: Signed synapse counts pre->post in the simulated networks (MANC/MaleCNS with >=5 floor, VNC synapses only for MaleCNS; FANC/BANC unfloored). Recomputed by the research agent from the authors' matrices.

wet_lab_status: No interneuron-level experimental validation (E1/E2/I1/I2 not manipulated in this paper or in Sapkal et al. 2026 follow-up). Only DN-level optogenetics (DNg100: speed/step frequency; DNb08: rhythmic leg movements in decapitated flies).
